text: This dignity of manners, which I recommend so much to you, is not only as different from pride, as true courage is from blustering, or true wit from joking; but is absolutely inconsistent with it; for nothing vilifies and degrades more than pride.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LXXVIII, to his son, London, August 20, Old Style 1749
